profileContract.path: presentationProfilePath supplied by root; no implicit A01/default timing

profileContract.phaseSubset: A cut may contain an ordered subset of phases. Strictly increasing phase IDs prohibit hidden repetitions; editor must retain full lesson sequence across cuts.
profileContract.nativeDuration: Play phases must contain the actual whole clip, or remaining clip when resuming. Sample time uses seconds directly; no speed or loop change.
profileContract.afterPlayback: Automatic label marks prepared pose before action and end pose after native one-shot.
profileContract.timingStatus: No invented ASR timestamps. Root supplies measured phases.
